title: the librarian's WATCHME probes report to CodeMother's gate
intention: The librarian's two standing WATCHME probes post their findings to CodeMother's WATCHME gate (to codemother, verb machines/watchme/watch, carry built by watch_carry with a holds reading): cairn/devices/librarian/probes/web_server_serves_dynamic_panes.py for ticket 72e8e3509287 and cairn/devices/librarian/probes/ask_spares_akien.py for ticket cd8096f9eeca; both tickets' watchme specs name the gate's receiver.
why: Outline 3.3.4 and 9.4.1.5 (Akien 2026-11-10): every WATCHME probe posts its finding to CodeMother's WATCHME gate. Measured 2026-11-10: test_librarian_probes_report_to_the_watch.py sealed red on exactly these two, posts verb '' and receiver is None. It was red before 386ea8131006 too, hidden by a reader KeyError that 386ea8131006 fixed.
how: Two probe edits in the 92-probe armed pattern (cairn/devices/cc/probes/the_shim_delivers_mail.py); two receiver writes through ticket_file.write_state; reseal the report proof.

clauses.claim: cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_probes_report_to_the_watch.py greens: every standing librarian WATCHME probe posts verb machines/watchme/watch to codemother, and every standing librarian watchme spec names the receiver {what: codemother watchme gate, in: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/watchme}

decisions.text: D1: web_server_serves_dynamic_panes.py: import watch_carry; _TICKET_ID = '72e8e3509287'; def _holds(context) -> bool: False when any render read by _read_renders has an empty or missing 'content', else True (no records holds). PROBE gets to='codemother', verb='machines/watchme/watch', carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds); the carry's 'ticket' key is dropped (watch_carry supplies it). Docstring: AUTHORITY none; it posts to CodeMother's WATCHME gate.

D2: ask_spares_akien.py: import watch_carry; _TICKET_ID = 'cd8096f9eeca'; def _holds(context): return once(context, 'survey', survey)['holds']. PROBE gets to='codemother', verb='machines/watchme/watch', carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds); body keeps nexus/kind/object and drops its 'ticket' key.

D3: for 72e8e3509287 and cd8096f9eeca, state['watchme']['receiver'] = dict(cairn.devices.codemother.machines.watchme.gate.RECEIVER), through ticket_file.write_state(plan, state, verb='cast', why='8b16f3e77013: the watchme receiver is CodeMother's gate').
D4: reseal cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_probes_report_to_the_watch.py; its bytes do not change.

in: the watchme receiver of tickets 72e8e3509287 and cd8096f9eeca
out: the verbless harbor_master posters (aider_shim, history_integrity, memory_curve, reading_is_declared_and_current)
